concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-settlement-reconciliation-batch-level-aggregate-settlement-details-report]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen Aggregate settlement details report for payout-batch credits, debits and counts by merchant/store/terminal/method/journal/date, with separate gross/net currencies, fee fields and report time zone; a payout reference is not bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Keep batch-level aggregate entries distinct from transaction-level Settlement details entries and bank payout receipt.
Column-configuration roles in this page must not be recast as report-generation roles.
